correctness.rationale: For the reciprocal polynomial, the disk inequalities are |1/d|<1 and 1+1/d>|t/d| (for real roots the latter gives positivity of both products at ±1, excluding roots beyond those endpoints given the product bound; for nonreal conjugates the product bound suffices). Summing 2d+1 at positive d and 2|d|−3 at negative d verifies E(H). HDJ Theorem 1.2 supplies the diagonalizable integral-power test. A double root gives a nontrivial Jordan block, with nonzero nilpotent term in every positive power on the expanding locus. For irreducible roots equal integral powers imply a root-of-unity ratio; the trace squared divided by d minus 2 is that ratio plus its inverse, a rational algebraic integer in [−2,2]. The real case has t=0 and the nonreal possibilities and converse powers in the record are exact. For the count of integer roots, |a+b|≤|ab| for |a|,|b|≥2, so there is no additional trace cap; taking absolute magnitudes yields D(H)−2H+1 ordered pairs, then sign choice, removal of 2(floor(sqrt(H))−1) equal pairs and division by two give the claimed integer-root class. The t=0 overlap is precisely d=−a² with |a|≥2; its subtraction and the diagonal subtraction cancel the separate t²=d contribution. The nonreal t²=2d and 3d families have t=±2j and ±3j respectively and determinants 2j² and 3j², with the trace cap automatic. This proves both exact formulas for all H≥2, and inserting the hyperbola estimate and dividing by 2H²−2 gives the stated errors including O(H^(−3/2)) for the proportion. The finite H=2..65 diagnostic and its code were inspected, not rerun; the analytic proof is independent of that diagnostic.

value.rationale: The simultaneous trace–determinant bound is a natural conjugacy-invariant height on this companion family. Counting at that height quantifies how exceptional the geometrically regular partitions are: the shrinking proportion and exact small-height corrections are useful and do not follow merely from knowing a finite test for each matrix. No claim about typicality among all integral matrices or other dimensions is warranted.
